summary: Eliminated harsh right-side glare and unnatural color seam on the /login screen by replacing the harsh split gradient with a continuous, soft, eye-comfort BukSU campus wash across both columns. Fixed auth card background using valid Tailwind stop bg-white/95 with dark:bg-[#0B1B3D]/90 backdrop-blur-2xl. Wrapped the BukSU institutional seal header in BukSULoginSidePanel.jsx with React Router Link to '/' with subtle hover scaling and gold text feedback, allowing desktop users to return to the landing page. Passed interactive Playwright seal click navigation tests, 5/5 auth store/service unit tests, 204/182 endpoint parity (UNMATCHED_COUNT=0), 60/60 agentic validation checks, and 4-way Playwright visual audit across desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) in both Light and Dark modes.

verification_results.seal_click_navigation: Passed (both desktop and mobile seal clicks route to /)
